review_candidates.title: MS365 Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: MS365 Administrator II Location: India - Remote Job Profile Summary Microsoft 365 (MS365) Administration is a technical discipline responsible for the configuration, security, and day-to-day operation of the organization's Microsoft 365 tenant. The MS365 Administrator manages tenant settings, licensing, and security/compliance policies to ensure a secure, reliable, and cost-effective cloud productivity environment. Career Level Summary Requires practical, working knowledge of Microsoft 365 admin
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Career Level Summary Requires practical, working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration gained through hands-on experience Performs moderately complex assignments independently, exercising judgment within established policies and procedures Receives general direction from senior administrators or IT leadership on non-routine issues Mid-level professional role within the IT career progression track Critical Competencies Excellence: Exceeds expectations by consistently demonstrating accountability, discipline, high performance, and a proven track record of exceptional results. Expertise: Possesses deep understanding of customer needs and continually grows and enhances skills to provide customer-focused solutions. Experience 3 - 6 years of experience administering Microsoft 365 tenants, including Exchange Online, Entra ID (Azure AD), and MS365 security/compliance tooling required.
